name: 伊丝卡
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_二_午祷上.md:696
who: Isca, a half-blood dragonkin girl of eleven from a town on the White Stone Plain, small and thin, about 138 cm, wholly covered by her clothes. Messy silver-white hair that sticks out in every direction, pushed under a hood two sizes too big that was her father's. Pale gold slit pupils that glow faintly in the dark. A thin face with a pointed chin and a smudge of grey on one cheek. On the backs of her small hands are scabs where scales were scraped off. She stands very straight, scared but not showing it.
face: FACE, as in the references: large, bright, gently rounded eyes with pale gold vertical pupils and a thin tapering dark-brown upper lash line; a thin little face with a pointed chin; a tiny nose; a small mouth held closed; a smudge of ash on one cheek; no scales visible. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
palette: silver white, pale gold, undyed greyish cloth, dusty brown, straw yellow
casual: Her road clothes: a washed-out coarse cloth dress to the knees that has no colour left, and over it her father's huge hooded cloak, the hood up and sagging past her brow, the hem trailing to the ankles; worn-through shoes tied on with straw rope. She stands very upright, hands at her sides, a serious closed-mouth look.
private: Her indoor clothes: the big cloak off and folded over one arm, a long-sleeved plain wool dress to the shins, wool stockings, patched shoes; the messy silver hair bare. She hugs the folded cloak to her chest, a serious, tired, closed-mouth face.
battle: Her standing-ground clothes: the big hooded cloak pulled tight and held closed with her fist at the chest, the hood up, a single reverse-growing dark scale hanging on a hemp cord at her neck; shoes tied tight. She stands straight with her feet planted, chin up, eyes wide open and facing forward, the mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: standing very straight and planted, the cloak gathered in one fist at her chest, the chin lifted, the gaze steady and the mouth closed; she carries no weapon.
formal: Her clean clothes: a plain wool dress with long sleeves, the silver hair combed and tied with a cord, the huge cloak folded over one arm, the one dark scale on its hemp cord at her neck. She stands straight with her hands clasped in front, a solemn closed-mouth face.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the oversized hood framing her face, the pale gold eyes facing the viewer, steady and grave, the mouth closed. Cold snow light from one side, a faint warm glow of a fire from the other. Foreground blur: the edge of a tall standing stone with scales stuck in its cracks and a few drifting snowflakes.

name: 薇洛
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_二_午祷上.md:752
who: Viro, a human-looking scale-hunter of twenty-eight who is secretly a half-blood dragonkin: tall, about 172 cm. Long wine-red hair in one thick braid. Ice-blue eyes with round human pupils, a long face, a sharp brow ridge and thin lips, so that when she does not smile she looks like a drawn blade. She keeps her outer garment on in front of other people, always. No scale shows anywhere. At her belt a brass one-litre measuring cup whose rim is cut with her school's mark. A quiet, wary, dangerous air.
build: 172 cm, tall and long-limbed, strong and sturdy with a fast back: a C-cup, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: wine red, ice blue, dark leather brown, brass, steel grey
casual: Her hunter's gear: a hard boiled-leather jerkin laced to the chin with thongs, fitted sleeves of the same hide, a hooded cape of dark wool over it, leather gloves; a short single-edged bloodletting knife with a slightly curved blade at her right hip (on the viewer's left when they face us), and the brass measuring cup hanging at her left hip (on the viewer's right when they face us), its rim etched with a faint rune that warms near dragon scale. Boots to the knee. She stands with a cool, level look and a closed mouth.
private: Her off-duty clothes: the armour coat off, a high-collared long-sleeved linen shirt buttoned to the chin under a plain wool vest, trousers, soft boots, the braid over one shoulder; the brass cup held in her hands. She does not smile, but the shoulders are lowered a little.
battle: Her hunting gear: the armour coat belted tight with leather bracers and a studded shoulder guard, the hood of a dark cloak up, the bloodletting knife held low in the right hand with the edge turned down, the left hand open, the brass cup still hanging at the belt; knees bent, the weight forward, the cold ice-blue eyes fixed ahead.
formal: Her festival clothes, worn with the collar hidden: a long deep wine-dyed wool dress to the shins, the one dyed garment she owns, a leather collar-band laced to the chin under a big hooded dark-wool cloak, hem trailing, the braid pinned up, black gloves; the brass cup polished at her belt, its etched rim glinting. She stands very straight, a cold, composed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the ice-blue eyes looking straight at the viewer, cold and measuring, the thin lips closed. Cold blue-white winter light from one side, a thin warm line of firelight on the other. Foreground blur: the wine-red braid and the brass rim of a measuring cup.

name: 路上有人
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_二_午祷上.md:818
who: The man on the road, a human sword-bearer of about forty whose name and origin he never gives: about 190 cm, wide and heavy through the shoulders, as steady as a boundary stone. Short grey-brown hair that looks cut with his own blade. Deep slate-grey eyes that look at the road longer than at people. A square face with one old scar across the bridge of the nose. People remember his sword and forget his face. On his back a plain two-handed greatsword with no pattern at all, in a scabbard wrapped in an old piece of leather.
build: 190 cm, broad and heavy-shouldered, solid and deep-chested, standing like a boundary stone.
palette: faded slate grey, dull steel, worn brown, ash
casual: His travelling gear: a faded traveller's cloak with the hood always down at the back, over a plain dark wool tunic with a leather belt; the plain greatsword in its leather-wrapped scabbard on his back; at the belt a waterskin and a whetstone. Old boots. He stands with his weight even, a level look and the mouth closed.
private: His off-duty clothes: the cloak off and folded over one arm, a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt, the belt loosened, the scabbarded greatsword held upright beside his shoulder; he looks off to the side, a quiet level look.
battle: His fighting gear: the cloak thrown back over the shoulders, the plain greatsword drawn and held in both hands low across the body with the point down toward the right, the empty scabbard left on his back; legs wide and planted, the face expressionless and fixed ahead.
formal: His cleanest clothes: the same cloak brushed and mended over a clean dark wool coat that closes with buttons, the hood down, the sword still in its scabbard on his back; his hands rest together at the front. He stands still, a plain, level look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned a little to the side as if watching a road, the deep slate-grey eyes only half toward the viewer, the scar across the nose clear, the mouth closed. Cold dusk light from one side, a small warm glow from the other. Foreground blur: a rutted road and the plain leather-wrapped hilt over his shoulder.

name: 茜贝尔
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_二_午祷上.md:874
who: Sibel, a human fire-hall priestess of twenty-four who tends the hearth of the Three Oaks hall: about 162 cm, sturdy and quick. Curly orange-red hair tied up carelessly with a strip of cloth, stray curls always falling over her forehead. Honey-coloured eyes, a round face with a scatter of freckles across the bridge of the nose. Her hands are covered in old burn marks from ten years of feeding the fire. A cheerful, brisk, welcoming air.
build: 162 cm, sturdy with quick hands: a B-cup, a trim waist and softly rounded hips.
palette: orange red, honey amber, undyed hemp, burnt leather brown, soot black
casual: Her hall clothes: a coarse undyed hemp robe that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, rolled to the elbows, with a scorched leather apron full of burnt holes tied over it; a ring of eight keys at the belt; iron fire tongs held in her right hand. She grins at the viewer with the lips closed.
private: Her off-duty clothes: the apron off, a loose long-sleeved wool dress to the shins, the sleeves pushed up, wool stockings; a mug held in both hands with the burn-marked hands in view, a sleepy contented closed-mouth smile.
battle: Her fighting gear: the scorched apron tied tight over the robe, thick leather gloves, a leather cap, the iron fire tongs held out forward in both hands like a short spear with a glowing log gripped in them; feet planted, the brows drawn together and the mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and ready, the feet apart, a glowing log gripped in the iron tongs and held forward, the brows drawn together and the mouth closed, no smile.
formal: Her festival clothes: a clean undyed hemp robe with a wide band of small red flame shapes embroidered along the hem and cuffs, a clean pale apron, the curly hair tied with a new red cloth, the ring of keys at the belt. She stands straight with the hands folded in front, a warm, composed closed-mouth smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the honey eyes looking straight at the viewer with a warm, open look, a small closed-mouth grin. Warm hearth light from below on one side, cool night blue on the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and the rim of a big wooden barrel with swords stacked in it.

name: 贾罗
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_二_午祷上.md:938
who: Jaro, a human thunder hunter of twenty-two: about 181 cm, lean and long-legged. Black hair with one forelock burned white by lightning. Pale thunder-violet eyes, and a smile whose one corner sits higher than the other. A branching lightning scar like an upside-down tree runs from his left shoulder up the side of the neck (on the viewer's right when they face us). He carries no iron at all because iron tingles in the storms. A quick, bright, reckless air.
build: 181 cm, lean and wiry with long legs, light on his feet.
palette: storm violet, black, lightning white, grey-brown hide, bone
casual: His hunter's gear: a storm-patterned hide cloak he skinned himself, over a plain dark wool shirt left open at the neck so the scar shows; a bone knife at the belt, no iron anywhere; soft-soled boots with no nails. He stands loose with one corner of the mouth lifted, a closed-mouth half grin.
private: His off-duty clothes: the hide cloak off and slung over one shoulder, a long-sleeved plain wool shirt, the collar open, soft boots; he stands with his thumbs in his belt and his head tilted back, an easy closed-mouth smile.
battle: His hunting gear: the hide cloak thrown back, leather bracers over the sleeves, the bone knife held low in the right hand, the left hand spread open as if reading the air, knees bent; the face tense and bright, the mouth closed.
formal: His festival clothes: his single dyed garment, a deep violet-blue wool coat held shut with a leather belt and one bone toggle, the hide cloak folded over the shoulder, the white forelock combed, the neck open to show the branching scar, a pale violet spark running along the toggle. He stands straight with a pleased half smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the thunder-violet eyes looking straight at the viewer with a reckless grin, the white forelock in the wind. Cold violet lightning light from one side, a warm lantern glow from the other. Foreground blur: a rain streak and a stripped white tree branch.

name: 菲妮
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_二_午祷上.md:994
who: Finny, a human tanner of twenty-four from the valley city's tannery: about 164 cm, sturdy with strong arms. Long peach-pink hair coiled up under an indigo headscarf that is spotted with splashes of dye. One small beauty mark between her brows. Olive-green eyes that do not blink while she looks at a hide, a round face with a small chin, lips pressed together. All ten of her fingers are stained brown by tanning liquor and will not wash clean. A quiet, absorbed, careful air.
build: 164 cm, sturdy with strong arms and a straight back: a C-cup, a slim waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: peach pink, indigo, olive green, tanning brown, oilcloth ochre
casual: Her tannery clothes: a long-sleeved wool dress under an oilcloth apron, the sleeves rolled above the elbow, the brown-stained hands in view; an indigo headscarf with dye splashes; a hide-scraping knife and a small jar of tanning liquor at the belt. She holds a piece of hide stretched in both hands, the lips pressed.
private: Her off-duty clothes: the apron off, a long-sleeved soft wool dress to the shins, the headscarf off and the peach-pink hair let down over one shoulder, wool stockings; the brown hands wrapped round a mug. A quiet, tired, closed-mouth look.
battle: Her fighting gear: the oilcloth apron tied tight over a leather jerkin and thick leather gloves, the hide-scraping knife held low in the right hand and a tough stretched hide gripped in the left like a shield, the headscarf knotted tight; feet apart, the lips pressed and the olive eyes unblinking.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced with the feet apart, a stretched hide held up on one arm and the scraping knife low in the other hand, the lips pressed and the eyes unblinking, no smile.
formal: Her festival clothes: the one dyed dress she keeps for it, a deep indigo wool dress with long sleeves that closes down the front with buttons, a clean pale headscarf, the peach-pink hair coiled up neatly; the stained brown hands folded in front. She stands straight with a shy closed-mouth look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the head bent a little, the olive-green eyes looking up at the viewer without blinking. Warm lantern light from one side, a cool blue-white from the other. Foreground blur: the edge of a stretched thunder hide with faint lightning patterns and a splash of indigo dye.

name: 博里
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_二_午祷上.md:1114
who: Bori, a young dwarf apprentice at the Roaring Cliff forge, seventy years old by dwarf reckoning and looking about seventeen: only about 132 cm, round and stout with short legs, but quick on his feet. A thin golden-brown beard that is still too short to braid, tied in one small knob. Light blue round eyes that squeeze into two slits when he laughs. A face smudged with forge ash, cold red ears and a red nose. Both hands are wrapped in cloth over bellows blisters. On his back a small round shield he made himself that nobody has bought. Cheerful, bouncy and eager.
palette: golden brown, light blue, forge orange, soot black, scorched leather brown
casual: His apprentice gear: a short scorched leather apron over a plain wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, heavy trousers and dwarf boots; both hands wrapped in cloth; a small hammer at his belt that he forged himself, and the small round shield on his back. He stands bouncing on his toes with a wide closed-mouth grin.
private: His off-duty clothes: the apron off, a long-sleeved loose wool shirt to the knee, thick wool socks and soft house shoes, the cloth wraps still on his hands, a mug held in both; he sways sleepily with a soft closed-mouth smile.
battle: His fighting gear: the scorched apron over a leather jerkin, a small iron cap, the small round shield held up on the left arm and the small hammer gripped in the right hand, feet wide in the stout boots; eyes wide, brows drawn together, the mouth closed and set.
formal: His best clothes: a clean dark wool vest with brass buttons over a white shirt, his face washed, the beard knob tied with a new cord, the small round shield polished and carried on his back; clean cloth wraps on the hands. He stands up straight, trying to look serious, with a closed-mouth smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned a little, the light blue eyes bright and looking straight at the viewer with a big closed-mouth smile. Orange forge light from below on one side, cool grey from the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and the rim of a small round shield.

name: 塞尔温·白石
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_二_午祷上.md:1421
who: Selwin of the White Stone, a human scribe of a small town on the White Stone Plain, a farmer's son who learned his letters from a temple priest; here around sixty, about 170 cm, thin with a slight stoop. Short white hair, warm hazel-brown eyes, a lined, patient face. His hands are caked with stone dust and he holds a mason's chisel and a wet leather pad. He is stubborn, never loud, and speaks in long careful sentences.
face: FACE, as in the references: a thin lined older man's face of about sixty: warm hazel-brown eyes under thin white eyebrows, deep lines at the eyes and mouth, a long nose, a closed patient mouth, short white hair. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
build: 170 cm, thin and stooped, with strong stone-dusty hands.
palette: stone dust white, hazel brown, ink black, worn wool brown, slate grey
casual: His scribe's work clothes: a plain brown wool tunic that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves with leather cuffs, a stained leather apron grey with stone dust, trousers and plain shoes; a mason's chisel in the right hand and a wet leather pad in the left. He stands with a slight stoop, a patient closed-mouth look.
private: His evening clothes: the apron off, a long soft undyed wool robe to the shins buttoned at the front, wool slippers, white dust still in the creases of his hands; he holds a half-finished wax tablet in both hands, a quiet tired look.
battle: His standing-ground gear: a dust-grey leather apron over the tunic, the chisel gripped like a short blade in the right hand and a stone mallet in the left, shoulders braced against the stoop; the face stubborn and set, the mouth closed.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: facing the viewer squared up and stubborn, the mallet and the chisel held low in front, the chin raised, the mouth closed, no smile.
formal: His clean clothes: a charcoal wool coat that closes down the front with plain buttons, buttoned to the neck, his hair neat; he holds a small slate tablet in both hands. He stands straight, a calm and stubborn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the hazel-brown eyes looking straight at the viewer, calm and stubborn, the mouth closed. Soft grey daylight from one side, a warm low light on the other. Foreground blur: the edge of a carved stone slab with rows of tiny cut letters and drifting stone dust.

name: 劫道的头子
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_二_午祷上.md:1435
who: The old road-robber chief, a human former scale-hunter of about fifty-five: about 175 cm, lean and tough. Grey-white beard, small sharp dark brown eyes that look first at a traveller's belt for a purse. The last two fingers of his left hand are missing, bitten off by a dragonkin (on the viewer's right when they face us). A weathered, hard, quick-witted face. He gives up fast when the odds are bad. His left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us) has only three digits: the thumb, the index finger and the middle finger; the ring finger and the little finger are gone at the knuckle, leaving two healed stumps. This three-fingered left hand is drawn clearly in every panel, and his right hand (on the viewer's left) has all five fingers.
face: FACE, as in the references: a weathered, hard older man's face of about fifty-five: small sharp dark brown eyes under heavy grey brows, a grey-white short beard, a crooked nose, deep lines, a thin closed mouth. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
build: 175 cm, lean and tough with a bent-forward stance, a fast cunning body.
palette: grey white, rust brown, dull olive, dark leather, dusty grey
casual: His road clothes: a worn-out hunter's hard leather jerkin that closes down the front with buttons, over a patched dull olive wool shirt, with a faded brown cloak, the hood down; a short hand axe at the right hip (on the viewer's left when they face us); trousers and cracked boots. His left hand with only three fingers rests on the belt (on the viewer's right when they face us). A sharp, wary look, the mouth closed.
private: His off-duty clothes: the jerkin off, a patched long-sleeved wool shirt, the cloak wrapped round his shoulders; a bowl held in the right hand and the three-fingered left hand held out in front (on the viewer's right when they face us); a tired, wary look.
battle: His ambush gear: the leather jerkin tight, a rag wrapped round the lower face and hanging at the neck, the cloak bundled on one shoulder, the hand axe raised in the right hand, the three-fingered left hand held out to signal (on the viewer's right when they face us); crouched and ready.
formal: His borrowed best clothes: a clean brown wool coat that closes down the front with buttons, the beard trimmed, a flat cap held in the right hand, the three-fingered left hand at his side (on the viewer's right when they face us). He stands awkward and humble, the mouth closed. The flat cap is in his right hand (on the viewer's left when he faces us); the hand hanging free at his side is the three-fingered left hand (on the viewer's right).
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned a little, the small dark brown eyes looking straight at the viewer, shrewd and tired. Cold dusk light from one side, a small warm campfire glow on the other. Foreground blur: a bare thorn branch and the edge of a rough hand axe.

name: 铜谷的王
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_二_午祷上.md:1449
who: The King of the Copper Valley, a human king of about fifty: about 175 cm, stout and heavy. Short curly copper-brown hair going grey at the sides, brown eyes, a fat, smooth face. Every finger is full of copper rings. On his head a copper crown set with a purple thunder core, the rim newly ringed with rubies. Pleased, calm, fond of counting thunder hides the way other kings count gold.
build: 175 cm, stout and heavy with a broad belly and soft hands.
palette: copper, purple thunder core, ruby red, deep brown, cream
casual: His court clothes: a heavy copper-brown velvet robe that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, trimmed with a band of storm-patterned thunder hide at the collar and hem, over a cream silk shirt; the copper crown with the purple core and the ring of rubies, copper rings on every finger; a belt with a copper buckle. He stands relaxed with a content closed-mouth smile.
private: His indoor clothes: the crown off and the rings kept on, a loose long-sleeved copper-brown robe to the ankles of western cut that closes down the front with a row of plain round brass buttons on a straight placket, with a soft turned-down collar, soft slippers; he holds a small bundle of thunder-hide scraps in his hands with a pleased look.
battle: His war clothes: bought bronze armour, a copper breastplate engraved with the valley arms worn over the robe, a plumed helmet with a small purple thunder core on its brow, a short ceremonial sword held point down in both hands; stout and heavy, the face calm and unworried.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: standing stout and unmoving with a short ceremonial sword held point down in both hands in front of him, the face calm and unworried, the mouth closed.
formal: His royal robes: a deep purple velvet robe fastened with a heavy copper clasp, edged with copper thread and storm-patterned thunder hide, the copper crown with its purple thunder core crackling faintly and the new ring of rubies around the rim, copper rings on every finger that hum softly; one hand on his belt. He stands straight, pleased, a smooth closed-mouth smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the brown eyes looking straight at the viewer, comfortable and pleased, the lips closed. Warm yellow-gold torchlight on one side, a faint violet glow from the thunder core on the other. Foreground blur: the glint of copper rings and a hanging thunder hide.

name: 天脊的族长
src: 诸国期/诸国期时段_二_午祷上.md:1407
who: The chief of the Dark-Scale clan of Skyridge, a male dragonkin who looks about sixty: about 183 cm, broad and tall. His scales are deep dark blue-green, layered thickly along the neck, jaw and backs of the hands; on his chest is a big scale carved with the clan's sign. His breath makes a fire dip. Amber vertical pupils, a lined heavy face, white-streaked hair. A cautious, slow, undecided air. His eyes are a clear bright amber with narrow vertical slit pupils like a lizard's, drawn as slits in every panel and every expression, never round, and the irises are amber, not brown. The clan sign on his chest is cut into one big raised dark blue-green scale plate the size of a palm that grows on his breastbone, a scale standing out from the skin, not a mark drawn on bare skin.
face: FACE, as in the references: a heavy, weathered older man's face of about sixty: amber vertical-pupil eyes under thick dark brows, deep dark blue-green scales layered along the temples and jaw, deep lines, a closed firm mouth, hair streaked with white. Skin shadows are a soft warm tone.
build: 183 cm, tall and broad with a deep chest and thick shoulders.
palette: deep dark blue-green, amber, grey-brown, bone white, ember orange
casual: His chief's clothes: the clan's long grey-brown wool robe that closes down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, the front opened at the throat to show the big chest scale carved with the clan sign, a heavy plain cord belt, boots; his hands, thick with dark scales, folded in front. He stands heavy and still, a slow, closed-mouth look.
private: His indoor clothes: the heavy robe loosened, a long-sleeved undyed wool shirt, soft boots, a rug over one shoulder; a cup held in both scaled hands, a tired, undecided look.
battle: His war gear: the grey-brown robe with the sleeves tied back, a heavy leather harness with dark metal plates strapped over it, a heavy staff with an iron-shod end held upright in the right hand, feet planted wide; the chest scale glowing faintly amber, the face grim and the mouth closed.
formal: His council robes: a long deep blue-green wool robe that closes down the front with buttons, edged in bone-white thread, the clan sign embroidered large across the chest above the carved scale, a silver chain; both scaled hands resting on the carved head of a staff. He stands tall and grave.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned slightly, the amber vertical-pupil eyes looking straight at the viewer, heavy and cautious, the mouth closed. Cold white snow light from one side, a warm low firelight on the other. Foreground blur: a dipping flame and drifting ash.
